blockers.description: Every remaining Admin-SDK mutation must use an exact, versioned, role-scoped, atomic command or be retired fail-closed.
Sensitive tenant, historical, assessment, privacy, incident, and evidence reads need persona-scoped redacted projections and integration coverage.
Evidence requires authorized upload sessions, object-generation binding, server hashing/type/size verification, malware controls, review separation, retention, and authorized download.
Framework, scoping, applicability, obligation, and control results must be based on immutable pinned source/input versions with one authoritative state model.
Append-only Rules and command receipts must be complemented by verifiable event chaining, continuity checks, independent checkpoints, and audited repair procedures.
Exports must contain the promised files/formats, fail atomically, be integrity-manifested, and be downloadable through short-lived authorized delivery.
Review/expiry schedules, notifications, escalation, retries, dead-letter handling, and reconciliation need idempotent tested workers and usable inboxes.
Legacy tenant data, random invitations, mutable histories, duplicate applicability stores, and missing revisions require idempotent migration plus per-tenant reconciliation reports.
Register production App Check, verify attested traffic and limited-use-token IAM, inventory all deployed regions, tombstone old endpoints, and prove their retirement.
Complete independent penetration/authorization testing, backup-restore and disaster-recovery exercises, load/cost limits, privacy review, and pilot acceptance.
